description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] Removes the brand's sending domain. A brand in domain mode goes back to sending from flayr.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/brands/{id}/sending-identity/domain.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_sending_domain_remove
title: Remove a brand's sending domain
